settings.label: Developer views
settings.help: Turns on the F11 debug view in game, for testers. It shows EldenNet's own numbers and words, never story or chat. Takes effect the next time the game starts.

settings.label: Record sessions
settings.help: Keeps a recording of each session's numbers, with no text and no names, for the developers' replay tools. Takes effect the next time the game starts.

settings.label: Log detail
settings.help: How much EldenNet writes to its log. Detailed helps with a bug report; Normal is enough otherwise. Changes at once.

settings.label: Preset
settings.help: Which models do the jobs. Cloud budget, on OpenRouter, suits most players; Custom keeps what your providers file says. A new preset adds its provider to Providers, where its key goes.

settings.label: Conversation's provider
settings.help: Where Conversation's calls go: one of the providers on Providers. If it does not list the job's model, choose one of its models below. Default: the preset's provider.

settings.label: Conversation's model
settings.help: The model that answers when you talk to a character, from the models its provider lists. Reset it to use the preset's provider and model again. Default: the preset's model.

settings.label: Quick lines' provider
settings.help: Where Quick lines' calls go: one of the providers on Providers. If it does not list the job's model, choose one of its models below. Default: the preset's provider.

settings.label: Quick lines' model
settings.help: The model for short lines said in the moment, such as a call-out in a fight. It needs a fast first word. Reset it to use the preset's provider and model again. Default: the preset's model.

settings.label: Prepared lines' provider
settings.help: Where Prepared lines' calls go: one of the providers on Providers. If it does not list the job's model, choose one of its models below. Default: the preset's provider.

settings.label: Prepared lines' model
settings.help: The model that prepares lines ahead of time, in batches, while nothing waits for them. Reset it to use the preset's provider and model again. Default: the preset's model.

settings.label: Memory's provider
settings.help: Where Memory's calls go: one of the providers on Providers. If it does not list the job's model, choose one of its models below. Default: the preset's provider.

settings.label: Memory's model
settings.help: The model that writes what characters remember of what happened. Reset it to use the preset's provider and model again. Default: the preset's model.

settings.label: Self-test's provider
settings.help: Where Self-test's calls go: one of the providers on Providers. If it does not list the job's model, choose one of its models below. Default: the preset's provider.

settings.label: Self-test's model
settings.help: The model the self-test measures. Reset it to use the preset's provider and model again. Default: the preset's model.
